title: OMNI Security Knowledge Cache
description: Deterministic normalized security-intelligence cache produced by scripts/update_threat_intel.py from the configured public sources. Security metadata only: it never stores credentials, secrets, private communications, or private-person dossiers.

schema_version.description: Cache format version emitted by the updater.

personal_data_policy.description: Human-readable statement bounding the cache to security metadata only.

record_count.description: Number of normalized records; must equal the length of records.

source.description: Configured source id this record was derived from.

entity_type.description: Normalized object type, e.g. attack-pattern, weakness, known-exploited-vulnerability, source-reference.

domain.description: Security domain of the source, defaults to cybersecurity.

layer.description: Optional coverage layer of the source.

id.description: Stable external identifier of the object when available.

external_id.description: Alternate external identifier used when id is absent.
